channel.title: The Points Guy - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Points Guy (thepointsguy.com)

item.title: Bilt Rent Day (March 1): Up to a 125% transfer bonus and new neighborhood experiences
item.description: Bilt Rewards is back with March Rent Day. Enjoy up to a 125% transfer bonus, double points on nonhousing purchases with Bilt cards and much more.

item.title: Hyatt is drastically changing its award chart — and many stays will be more expensive
item.description: Hyatt's World of Hyatt program is changing its award chart, introducing new digital tools and making other changes.

item.title: How to choose an airline credit card
item.description: Are you struggling to find the right airline credit card? Our guide shows you how to choose an airline credit card with the benefits you're looking for.

item.title: How 1 state may upend how you use your credit card — and what you can do about it
item.description: A look at how credit card reform efforts, including a new law in Illinois restricting interchange fees on taxes and tips, have shifted to the states.

item.title: Chase adds Wyndham Rewards as a new hotel partner — should you transfer your points?
item.description: Chase Ultimate Rewards has added Wyndham Rewards as a new hotel transfer partner, but most travelers will find better value elsewhere.

item.title: Delta Platinum vs. Delta Reserve: Picking a premium card for Delta perks
item.description: The Delta Reserve and Delta Platinum credit cards share many benefits, but there are some key differences. Here's how to figure out which card is best for you.

item.title: Double-dip these Rakuten and Amex offers to save big on your next Viator tour
item.description: Learn how to maximize your savings on a tour or activity through Viator today.

item.title: Clear's new 'e-gates' are now live at 37 airports — with more to come in 2026
item.description: Clear, which fast-tracks paying members through airport security, has expanded a new high-tech setup to dozens of major hubs.

item.title: How to reach Atmos Rewards elite status with the Atmos Summit Visa
item.description: Learn how the Atmos Rewards Summit card lets you earn elite status through spending. Plus, key perks, status point thresholds, and real-world strategies.

item.title: Coming soon: Use your Amex Resy credit at wineries and even more restaurants
item.description: Amex cardholders will soon see more restaurants and wineries on Resy as Tock joins the platform. Here’s what it means for your dining credits.
